text:
Maya: Quick check — we're about to roll out a per-customer allowlist toggle for AcmeCorp (contract AC-2024). Canary audience = 5 VIP tenants in eu-west. Need confirmation on enforcement mode + ops playbook updates.
Dan: Quick Q — is this a hard deny (block) if tenant not on allowlist or a soft fallback?
Maya: Hard deny. Contract requires the feature disabled unless explicitly enabled for the tenant. Also we need audit logs for every decision.
Priya: Add: we must tag the flag with contract_id and sla_tier in the console so support can triage.
Sam: Ping runtime/flags team — @Leo can runtime do tenant-scoped flags and canary lists without affecting global batching?
Leo: Runtime supports tenant-scoped feature flags. We can target tenant_ids list. Important: include tenant_id in cache/batching key; otherwise KV cache could leak prefixes across customers.
Maya: Good call. Example config I'm planning to push to feature-store: 
```
feature_flags:
  enterprise_per_customer_allowlist:
    kind: tenant_flag
    enforcement: hard
    tenants: ["acme-123","acme-vip-9","acme-ops","acme-qa","acme-internal"]
    metadata:
      contract_id: "AC-2024"
      sla: "enterprise-0"
    audit: true
```
Priya: Also ensure the UI shows "contract-bound" on the toggle and prevents accidental global flip.
Sam: Ops checklist suggestion: smoke on staging, enable canary for 2h, monitor error_rate and P95 latency. Acceptance: error_rate <= 0.5% and P95 delta <= 10ms.
Rollout-bot: Scheduled canary window: 2025-08-01T14:00Z -> 2025-08-01T16:00Z for tenants: acme-123, acme-vip-9, acme-ops, acme-qa, acme-internal.
Dan: Who signs off on canary go/no-go?
Maya: Priya approves post-smoke; Sam owns monitoring and will call rollback if metrics breach.
Priya: I'll update the rollout playbook and add an abort rule: if audit events missing or tenant decision mismatch -> abort and flip off specific tenant flags.
Sam: I'll open a short RFC/PR for the feature_flag schema change (add contract_id field + enforcement enum) and tag reviewers @Leo @Dan.
Leo: I'll review the RFC and check runtime cache instrumentation. Also can we add a short integration test ensuring tenant_id in cache key?
Maya: Yes — include a unit test and an e2e smoke job on staging. Thanks all, updating console labels now. :thumbsup:
Sam: I'll also add a quick note to on-call rotation for the roll window.
Maya: Perfect. Will post final rollout plan here once PRs are ready.
